items.desc_en: A holotape containing medical information.  Can be used to enter information into your PIPBoy.
items.desc_zh: 一片载有医学数据的全息磁盘。使用磁盘可以把上面的数据下载到哔哔小子里。

items.desc_en: A holotape with the writing "Security Log" on the label.  You can use it to transfer the data it contains to your PIPBoy.
items.desc_zh: 一片全息磁盘，标签上写着“保安记录”。使用磁盘可以把上面的数据下载到哔哔小子里。

items.desc_en: The label on this holotape reads: "Alpha Experiment Log"
items.desc_zh: 这个全息磁盘上面标着“阿尔法试验记录”。

items.desc_en: The label on this holotape reads: "Delta Experiment Log"
items.desc_zh: 这个全息磁盘上面标着“德尔塔试验记录”。

items.desc_en: This holotape has been updated with medical evidence from Vree of the BoS.  It can be used to transfer the data to your PIPBoy.
items.desc_zh: 这是钢铁兄弟会的弗蕾给你的新版医学记录磁盘。使用磁盘可以把上面的数据下载到哔哔小子里。

items.desc_en: A holotape, with a rough symbol of the Brotherhood of Steel inscribed on it.  Use the tape to transfer the data to your PIPBoy.
items.desc_zh: 一片标着钢铁兄弟会符号的全息磁盘。使用磁盘可以把上面的数据下载到哔哔小子里。

items.desc_en: This holotape looks like it was set to record audio data from a radio.  Use the tape to transfer the information to your PIPBoy.
items.desc_zh: 这个全息磁盘上好像记录了来自一个无线电的语音信息。使用磁盘可以把上面的数据下载到哔哔小子里。

items.desc_en: A flare.  Creates light for a short period of time.  The paper is a little worn, but otherwise it is in good condition.  It is lit.
items.desc_zh: 可以在短时间内发出相当明亮的光，纸卷本身已经相当的老，但是信号弹本身却还能够使用。它已经点亮。

items.desc_en: A high explosive, consisting of nitroglycerin mixed with the absorbent substance kiselguhr.  Includes a timer, which is ticking.
items.desc_zh: 强大力量的炸药，是用硝化甘油所制，通常用来炸开门或者暗杀。上面有一个计时器。计时器正在倒计时。

items.desc_en: A Wattz Electronics C-Radz model Geiger Counter.  Detects the presence and strength of radiation fields.  It is on.
items.desc_zh: 一个瓦仑兹电子C-Radz型盖氏计算器。用来计算放射线强度的仪器。它已经打开了。

items.desc_en: A Wattz Electronics C-U model motion sensor.  Detects the movement of biological material over a distance of meters using a tuned radar device.  It is on.
items.desc_zh: 瓦仑兹电子C-U型动感探知器。可以探知数公尺内任何生物的动作。它已经打开了。

items.desc_en: A chunk of Cordex, a military brand of plastic explosives.  Highly stable, very destructive.  Includes a timer, which is ticking.
items.desc_zh: 军用的塑胶炸弹，相当稳定，但破坏力很的强，可以用来炸门或者暗杀。上面有一个记时器。计时器正在倒计时。

items.desc_en: A RobCo Stealth Boy 3001 personal stealth device.  Generates a modulating field that transmits the reflected light from one side of an object to the other.
items.desc_zh: 这是RobCo公司所设计的隐身小子3001型个人隐型装置，它可以让别人的视线直接穿过你而看到你身后的景物。它已经开始工作了。

items.desc_en: You see Ed.  Ed's dead.
items.desc_zh: 你看到艾德，他已经死了。

items.desc_en: You are bartering for Tandi's release.
items.desc_zh: 你为为了释放坦蒂而拼命。

items.desc_en: Gizmo, former crime boss of Junktown, is dead.  And pretty stinky, too.
items.desc_zh: 吉斯莫，曾经是迦克镇的大黑帮头目。现在他死了，并且非常的臭。

items.desc_en: A desk.  After further observation, you decide that it is still a desk.
items.desc_zh: 一个书桌，在进一步观察它之后，你发现……它还是一个书桌。

items.desc_en: A holotape containing information relating to the Brotherhood of Steel.  Can be used to enter information into your PIPBoy 2000.
items.desc_zh: 这个全息磁盘上记载着关于钢铁兄弟会的许多信息。使用磁盘可以把上面的数据下载到哔哔小子里。

items.desc_en: Barter for this option if you want light healing.
items.desc_zh: 如果你的手被刀割伤了，请购买这个。

items.desc_en: Barter for this option if you want medium healing.
items.desc_zh: 如果你在战斗中中弹了，请购买这个。

items.desc_en: Barter for this option if you want lots of care and heavy healing.
items.desc_zh: 如果你快死掉了但你还不想死的话，就买这个。

items.desc_en: A keycard with a security level encoded within it's very simple electronics.
items.desc_zh: 一张上面有通行资料的卡，里面有相当简单的电子装置。

items.desc_en: An electronic transmission device, with a very simple, and large, toggle button.  It looks like it was recently made and designed for very large hands.
items.desc_zh: 一种电子控制设备，上面有相当大的按钮，看起来是最近才制造的，而且是专门为手大的人所设计的。

items.desc_en: An electronic security key, color coded yellow.
items.desc_zh: 黄色的电子安全门的钥匙。

items.desc_en: You think this might be a carving of the "Pip Boy" but you can't be sure.
items.desc_zh: 你认为这很有可能是哔哔小子的雕像，但你又不能肯定。

items.desc_en: Upon further inspection, you still have no idea what this is.
items.desc_zh: 一种流行的情色杂志。

items.desc_en: You have no idea what "Instant Spaghetti" means.
items.desc_zh: 你不知道什么是“意大利面条”。

placements.region: Master's Lair 大师巢穴 1–2 层

items.name_en: Small Dusty Box Of Some Sort
items.desc_en: A television dinner.  You're not sure, but it's definitely not edible.  You're not quite sure if it ever was.
items.desc_zh: 一盒电视晚餐，你不确定，但是那一定不能吃了

items.desc_en: A technical repair manual on the T-51b Power Armor.
items.desc_zh: 一本如何修理T-51b动力装甲的手册。

items.desc_en: You see a Systolic Motivator.  This unusual piece of machinery is very small.
items.desc_zh: 一个心脏收缩器，这一部机器相当小。

items.desc_en: A compendium of events and important recordings from a Vault computer system.  Possibly damaged.
items.desc_zh: 这是来自避难所计算机上的重要影像，也许已经坏了。
有了这个口令就可以通过了，再看也不会有什么秘密了。

items.desc_en: A suit of T-51b Power Armor.  The hardening process has improved the defensive capability of this high-tech armor system.
items.desc_zh: 一套T-51b动力装甲。加强的工艺可以增加这件装甲的防御能力。

items.desc_en: A modified Winchester P94 plasma rifle.  The plasma bolt chamber has been hotwired to accelerate the bolt formation process.  Min ST: 6.
items.desc_zh: 一支改造过的温彻斯特P94型电浆来福枪。电浆发射器已被改造了，因此电浆的速度会加快。最小力量：6。

items.desc_en: An improved version of the classic Brass Knuckles.  The Spiked Knuckles do more damage, tearing into the flesh of your opponent in unarmed combat.  Min ST: 1.
items.desc_zh: 一个改良后的拳套，上面的刺可以造成更多的伤害，在空手战斗中相当有用。最小力量：1。

items.desc_en: A "Big Frigger" Power Fist from BeatCo.  Considered by many to be the ultimate weapon to use in unarmed combat.  Others are just scared.  Powered by small energy cells.  Min ST: 1.
items.desc_zh: 这个手套可以增加你挥拳的力量，很多人都认为这是空手战斗最佳的装备，使用小型电池。最小力量：1。

items.desc_en: A high-quality combat knife, the Stallona is from SharpWit, Inc.  The edge of this blade is guaranteed sharp for over a decade of use!  Min ST: 2.
items.desc_zh: 高级战斗刀，刀身的钢材来自锋锐公司。刀身保证十年内都是尖锐的。最小力量：2。

items.desc_en: A random pile of literature regarding the field of Chemistry.  The papers on Molecular Chemistry are particularly interesting.
items.desc_zh: 一叠化学的研究记录，其中原子化学的部分尤其有趣。

items.desc_en: A holotape recording of an audio transmission.
items.desc_zh: 这是一片记录着语音信息的全息磁盘。

items.desc_en: A superior version of Combat Armor.  The Brotherhood of Steel have made many improvements over the standard version.
items.desc_zh: 一种更先进的战斗装甲，钢铁兄弟会在普通的装甲上面作了很多的改进。

items.desc_en: This shining armor provides superior protection against energy attacks.  The three Tesla Attraction Coil Rods disperse a large percentage of directed energy attacks.
items.desc_zh: 这一个装甲是专门设计用来抵挡能量攻击的装甲，上面装有3个德斯拉线圈，可以吸收大部分的能量伤害。

items.desc_en: A .223 rifle modified and cut down to a pistol.  This is a one-of-a-kind firearm, obviously made with love and skill.  Min ST: 5.
items.desc_zh: .223来福枪改造而成的手枪。这是一只独一无二的武器，显然是由一个武器高手改造出来的。最小力量：5。

items.desc_en: A Winchester City-Killer 12-gauge combat shotgun, bullpup variant.  In excellent condition, it has the optional DesertWarfare environmental sealant modification for extra reliability.  Min ST: 5.
items.desc_zh: 温彻斯特－城市杀手战斗霰弹枪，更适合在空旷的地方使用。最小力量：5。
